course_position.stage_name: Consolidation, Fluency, Confidence, and Integrated Review

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice polite disagreement with hedging and a concrete alternative.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two adults choose between different plans for a shared evening, trip, or errand.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Disagreeing softly, explaining a concern, and proposing another option.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss two possible plans and one of them partly disagrees while keeping the tone cooperative.

main_focus.name: hedged disagreement with jag håller delvis med, men and jag är inte säker på att
main_focus.description: Use softer stance phrases to disagree without sounding abrupt.
model_examples: Jag håller delvis med, men det blir nog för stressigt.
Jag är inte säker på att det är den bästa lösningen.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 3-4 hedged disagreement or partial-agreement phrases naturally in the discussion.

vocabulary_target.theme: choosing a plan and disagreeing politely
useful_chunks: Jag är inte säker på att...
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use disagreement phrases with practical plan vocabulary and a cooperative tone.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker suggests a plan that seems reasonable but has a downside.
dialogue_shape.middle: They express partial agreement, name the concern, and compare an alternative.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose a compromise or decide what information is needed first.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat stance frames with different reasons rather than escalating disagreement

focus: the plan or option being questioned
the concern behind the polite disagreement
the compromise or alternative that is preferred

sentence_focus: one sentence with Jag håller delvis med, men
one sentence with Jag är inte säker på att
one sentence naming a practical concern
one sentence explaining which option is preferred and why
